notes.title: Fixed Mode Select Bug
notes.content:
Fixed bug created on the Day 02 update where new players were unable to select game mode which prevented them from starting the game.

New players can now select a game mode again and start the game.

notes.title: Day 03 Patch
notes.content:
-Added to the aesthetic design of Stages 07 & 08
-Changed all of the bookshelf sprites
-Fixed issue where the game-time did not display in the ending finish stat screen
-Added more frames of animation to the poison (green) hazard pools and the shallow blood (red) sea sprites
-adjusted some SFX

-Fixed bug where player may inadvertently hit the Stage 08 Boss before the Boss was activated which would crash the game.

-Fixed Bug exclusive to expert mode (permadeath) when player defeats boss they will no longer get stuck on the screen following the ability choice screen.
